    Maps out of block quiver modules #

    A family of linear maps ψ j : V → M_{vtx j} that intertwines the moves (a ψ_i = ψ_j ∘ g a i when a moves i to j) and is killed by arrows without a move gives a module homomorphism f ↦ Σ_j ψ_j (f j) (Compat.toHom).

    Type (max u u_1)

    A compatible family of maps from the blocks into M.

    • ψ : C.P → V →ₗ[k] M
    • mem_vsp (j : C.P) (y : V) : (self.ψ j) y ∈ D.vsp M (C.vtx j)
    • move (a : D.Q.A) (i j : C.P) (y : V) : C.next a i = some j → D.α a • (self.ψ i) y = (self.ψ j) ((C.g a i) y)
    • kill (a : D.Q.A) (i : C.P) (y : V) : C.next a i = none → D.α a • (self.ψ i) y = 0
